queryPlans.sql: SELECT seq FROM events WHERE project_id=? AND seq>? ORDER BY seq LIMIT 201

plan.detail: SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX events_project_sequence (project_id=? AND seq>?)

queryPlans.sql: SELECT seq FROM events WHERE project_id=? AND json_extract(payload,'$.sessionId')=? AND type='session.delta' AND seq>? ORDER BY seq DESC LIMIT 257

plan.detail: SEARCH events USING COVERING INDEX events_session_type_sequence (project_id=? AND <expr>=? AND type=? AND seq>?)

queryPlans.sql: SELECT data FROM records WHERE kind='message' AND json_extract(data,'$.sessionId')=? AND project_id=? ORDER BY rowid

plan.detail: SEARCH records USING INDEX records_kind_session (kind=? AND <expr>=?)
